sermon.title: Is God Love? - January 22, 2023
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Following “Is Love a Lie?”, this message answers: God is love. He provided Himself as the Lamb, was wounded for our sins, and died for us while we were sinners. His love is for all who repent; He transforms us and delivers the godly, as with Noah and Lot.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear.

faqs.question: Who lies, God or men?
faqs.answer: Men lie; we are misusing the word love.

faqs.question: What did they do to His head?
faqs.answer: Pushed in a crown of thorns and beat it with a rod.

faqs.question: How does he correct himself?
faqs.answer: From “when I was a boy” to “when I was a sinner.”

faqs.question: Were Old Testament saints forgiven?
faqs.answer: Yes—through the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

faqs.question: What can Christ save you from?
faqs.answer: Disease, wasted money, drugs and alcohol, bad relationships and a horrible past.

faqs.question: What are you missing without goals for God?
faqs.answer: Eternal real estate for your spirit.
